name: Zephyra
look: a young pale pegasus foal with a silver-white coat, a flowing cloud-grey mane and tail and a pair of small silver-white wings still too big for it
temperament: Skittish and playful; it will not stay on the ground and shadows her through the air
scenePlacement: cantering at her side with its small wings half spread, mane streaming
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
